items.claim_text: A team at Harvard Business School studied more than 13 million credit card payments in New York City taxis, and found that higher suggested tip rates led passengers to leave more money.

C1.reason: 取引件数・タクシー研究・高い推奨率によるチップ増加はLedgerに沿うが、研究チームをHarvard Business Schoolとする固有名の帰属はLedgerに裏付けられていない。
